daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you major grounding energy today, Taurus. This is your moment to lean into what actually feels good instead of what you think should feel good. Trust your gut—it's rarely wrong.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, the vibe is all about authenticity. If there's someone on your mind, a genuine conversation could shift things. No games, just real talk. That's what's magnetic right now.
daily.career: Your practical energy is through the roof today. This is the perfect time to tackle that project you've been overthinking or have that meeting you've been anxious about. You've got the momentum—use it.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slow, intentional movement today. Think yoga, walks, or stretching rather than high-intensity stuff. Hydrate well and maybe journal about what your nervous system actually needs from you.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your perspective this week, Taurus. You're feeling less stuck and more curious about what's possible. Trust the little synchronicities showing up—they're breadcrumbs toward something real.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Someone might surprise you with genuine interest in what you actually think. Let your guard down a tiny bit—it's safe.
weekly.career: Your energy is magnetic without trying too hard. People are noticing your stability and follow-through. This is a great moment to speak up about what you want, even if it feels premature.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slowness this week. Stretch more, rush less. Moving with intention rather than speed will feel way better. Rest isn't laziness—it's how you recharge your whole vibe.
